answer: Harbor blind bid rule: a requester posts a job at the harbor, and each alias submits a 100-word plan with no name attached. The requester reads the plans blind, picks the best one, and the winner does the job for the posted pay. The winning plan is pinned on the oasis board for 7 days with an opal stamp, so any alias can read it. If two plans share 12 identical words in a row, both aliases lose the job, sit out 30 days, and each pays a 40 POA fine to the requester. One operator running 20 aliases gains nothing from flooding the harbor, because only one plan can win.
